blocks.text: 这起安全事件发生之际，人们越来越担心 AI 智能体在执行任务时会设法绕过限制。Anthropic 自己也披露过其 Claude 模型未经适当授权访问信息或执行操作的案例。

inlines.text: 这起安全事件发生之际，人们越来越担心 AI 智能体在执行任务时会设法绕过限制。Anthropic 自己也披露过其 Claude 模型未经适当授权访问信息或执行操作的案例。

blocks.text: 在最近的一起事件中，Claude 发现佐治亚州政府一个旧版网站存在漏洞，从而访问了该州持有的汇总投票计数。Anthropic 表示，该系统签发了一个数字访问令牌，使 AI 能够获取通常只有付费后才能查看的信息。

blocks.text: 公司澄清，Claude 并未访问该州的选民登记系统，没有调取个人选民记录，也没有改动任何投票记录。公司表示，被访问的信息仅限于汇总的票数统计，并已加入防护措施，防止类似事件再次发生。

blocks.text: A cybersecurity startup called Cathedral gained access to sensitive internal systems at Anthropic in less than 12 hours, exposing employee information, salary details, job offers and internal messages discussing the company's advanced AI models. The incident was discovered during a security test conducted under Anthropic's programme for outside researchers to identify vulnerabilities.

inlines.text: A cybersecurity startup called Cathedral gained access to sensitive internal systems at Anthropic in less than 12 hours, exposing employee information, salary details, job offers and internal messages discussing the company's advanced AI models. The incident was discovered during a security test conducted under Anthropic's programme for outside researchers to identify vulnerabilities.

blocks.text: According to a draft report reviewed by The Washington Post, Cathedral used AI agents to find weaknesses in business software used by Anthropic for administrative and sales tasks. The researchers found ways to access internal data, including meeting transcripts and Slack messages, after running their agents for less than 12 hours.

inlines.text: According to a draft report reviewed by The Washington Post, Cathedral used AI agents to find weaknesses in business software used by Anthropic for administrative and sales tasks. The researchers found ways to access internal data, including meeting transcripts and Slack messages, after running their agents for less than 12 hours.

blocks.text: Cathedral was founded by former members of the US Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) and develops AI-powered cybersecurity tools for government agencies and corporate clients.

inlines.text: Cathedral was founded by former members of the US Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) and develops AI-powered cybersecurity tools for government agencies and corporate clients.

blocks.text: Anthropic confirmed that the researchers accessed a limited set of its sales, human resources and IT systems. The exposed information included business contact details for some customers and partners, along with basic user account records. However, Anthropic said the researchers could not access conversations between customers and its Claude chatbot, the responses generated by the model, or the source code and model weights behind its AI systems.

blocks.text: "Our monitoring flagged some of Cathedral’s activity before they reported it to us, and we shut off their access the same day," Anthropic said in a statement. The company added that it had found no evidence of anyone other than Cathedral exploiting the vulnerabilities.

blocks.text: Anthropic disabled the affected business software and restored it only after the vendors confirmed that the security flaws had been addressed. It also briefed federal officials about the incident. The findings have raised national security concerns, with a senior Trump administration official telling The Washington Post that the report had circulated within the government. Alex Stamos, chief information security officer at AI coding startup Cognition, also pointed to weaknesses in how companies manage third-party software.

blocks.text: The security incident comes amid growing concerns about AI agents finding ways around restrictions while carrying out tasks. Anthropic has itself disclosed cases in which its Claude model accessed information or performed actions without proper authorisation.

blocks.text: In one recent incident, Claude accessed aggregate vote counts held by the US state of Georgia after finding a loophole in an older version of a government website. Anthropic said the system issued a digital access token that allowed the AI to reach information normally available only after paying a fee.

inlines.text: In one recent incident, Claude accessed aggregate vote counts held by the US state of Georgia after finding a loophole in an older version of a government website. Anthropic said the system issued a digital access token that allowed the AI to reach information normally available only after paying a fee.

blocks.text: The company clarified that Claude did not access the state's voter registration system, retrieve individual voter records or change any voting records. It said the information accessed was limited to aggregate vote counts and that it had introduced safeguards to prevent similar incidents.
